overall: The AG found that a board member individually violated the Open Meeting Law by emailing his opinion on public business to a quorum of the Board, though the violation was not intentional. Ordered compliance and disclosure of the email at an open meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting by email on April 21, 2013, through a board member's email to a quorum.
allegations.key_passage: we likewise find that, while attempting to respond to a question posed in the complainant's email, Mr. Ventura individually violated the Open Meeting Law by sending an email sharing his opinion on a matter of public business within the Board's jurisdiction to a quorum of the Board

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Disclose the content of the board member's April 21, 2013 email during a properly posted open meeting
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and order the Board to disclose the content of Mr. Ventura's April 21, 2013 email during a properly posted open meeting.
